_source: docs/build-engine-rulebook.md, section 'Every draft'. Wording copied by script, word for word.

_kinds.engine_auto: Engine-labelled email. In supervised mode: a Gmail draft for Matt, never sent.
_kinds.matt_sends: Drafted for Matt; Matt presses send.
_kinds.still_needed_line: Only as the 'Still needed' line of a reminder or confirmation already due.
_kinds.embedded_line: A fixed line inside an email Matt sends.
_kinds.matt_sets: Matt sets it himself. The engine never sends it.

vacation_reply.title: Layer 1: Gmail vacation reply (you set it)
vacation_reply.text:
Away until Monday 9 November

Hi, thanks for your email. I'm away until Monday 9 November and your message is safe in my inbox. If your files save automatically you'll get a short confirmation; if not, they're still safe and I'll confirm when I'm back. Previews go out from Monday 9 November, and I'll reply to anything that needs me personally by Wednesday 11 November.

Matt, Propulsion · This is an automatic reply.
